mqtt_setup.title: MQTT connection
mqtt_setup.description: Reuse the MQTT connection already configured in Home Assistant. Automatic setup can use the running official Mosquitto app and its managed credentials. For installation, advanced TLS or an existing setup in progress, [open MQTT configuration](/config/integrations/dashboard/add?domain=mqtt), then return and choose Use configured MQTT. Atmoce must publish to the same broker.

broker.title: Configure MQTT broker
broker.description: These settings are passed to the official Home Assistant MQTT integration, which tests and stores the credentials. This does not change the broker configured in your Atmoce gateway. For TLS, use the matching port (usually 8883).

select_gateway.title: Select an Atmoce gateway
select_gateway.description: Select a gateway found on the MQTT broker, or enter its serial number manually.

manual.title: Atmoce serial number
manual.description: No new gateway was selected. Enter the gateway serial number (SN). Entities will wait for telemetry on atmoce/gateway/YOUR_SN/monitor. Adding a gateway does not send battery commands.

confirm.title: Atmoce discovered
confirm.description: Add Atmoce gateway {serial}? Adding it does not send battery commands.

progress.discover: Listening for Atmoce gateways on MQTT (10 seconds)…

error.invalid_serial: Use letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (maximum 64 characters).
error.mqtt_not_ready: The Home Assistant MQTT client is not ready. Finish MQTT configuration and try again.
error.cannot_connect_mqtt: Home Assistant could not validate this broker connection. Check the broker, credentials, port and TLS settings.
error.automatic_mqtt_unavailable: No running official Mosquitto app is available, or Home Assistant could not obtain its discovery configuration. Enter the broker manually or open MQTT configuration.
error.mqtt_setup_in_progress: MQTT setup is already in progress. Finish it in Settings → Devices & services, then choose Use configured MQTT.

abort.already_configured: This Atmoce gateway is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: This message is not valid Atmoce monitor telemetry.
abort.discovery_in_progress: A manual Atmoce setup is already in progress.

init.title: Telemetry availability
init.description: Power commands require fresh telemetry. A disconnected broker or expired sample makes the monitoring entities unavailable.

options.automatic: Use the running Home Assistant Mosquitto broker

set_battery_control.name: Set battery control
set_battery_control.description: Set battery operation mode, power and target state of charge. Omitted power and target SOC use the prepared values.

power.name: Power
power.description: Power in kW; must not exceed the fresh device limit.
